sentences.11.5 Yrke: Jeg er turistguide: 11.5 Occupation: I am a tour guide
sentences.Hver sommer møter jeg turister og viser: Every summer I meet tourists and show them around the city centre.
sentences.Jeg forteller om byens historie og om al: I tell them about the city's history and about all the buildings.
sentences.Jeg snakker flytende engelsk, tysk og fr: I speak fluent English, German and French.
sentences.Turistene spør om alt mulig rart, og jeg: The tourists ask about all sorts of strange things, and I answer as well as I can.
sentences.Tromsø er den største byen i Nord-Norge,: Tromsø is the biggest city in Northern Norway, and the city is also called the Paris of the North.
sentences.Hvor mange innbyggere er det her?: How many inhabitants are there here?
sentences.Det er cirka 75 000 innbyggere. Her til: There are about 75,000 inhabitants. Here on the right you can see the Arctic Cathedral.
Oh, that was beautiful. We're a bit hungry now. Where can we find the best restaurants?
sentences.Det er mange gode restauranter i sentrum: There are lots of good restaurants in the centre.
sentences.Hva liker folk best å gjøre her?: What do people like doing best here?
sentences.Mange liker å dra på tur i den fantastis: Many like to go on trips in the fantastic nature. In the winter both locals and tourists try to photograph the northern lights.
